dev.qa_notes: QA must test on dev.life-ai.app (NEVER production life-ai.app). Steps: (1) inject auth_credentials + custom-server-url=api-dev into localStorage per CLAUDE.md; (2) open an existing session; (3) open the model picker and select a non-default model (e.g., 'opus 4.6' for claude, 'gpt-5.4' for codex); (4) verify a chip appears immediately LEFT of the yolo/permission badge showing the model name with a cube-outline icon; (5) navigate to a different session, then return to the first session; (6) verify the chip is STILL present and the picker shows the same model (persistence intact); (7) force-reload the page (Ctrl+F5) and verify chip + picker still show the selected model after MMKV reload; (8) select 'default model' in the picker and verify the chip disappears and the footer row hides (when permission mode is also default); (9) repeat steps 3-8 on mobile viewport 390x844 — verify no layout overflow, chip sits beside yolo chip without truncating. Desktop + mobile both required per CLAUDE.md E2E rule. No production testing.
